Agent Name: WebServing_Expert  
Step Number: 3  
Reason for Mistake: The WebServing_Expert erroneously calculated the number of winners for American Idol as 24, assuming one winner per year from the start of the show in 2002 to the year 2025. However, the show has not been consistently associated with one season per year, as certain years did not feature new seasons, and other sources explicitly provide the actual count of winners. The failure lies in not verifying this assumption directly from reliable sources, instead relying on an overly simplistic formula that led to incorrect results. This error resulted in an inaccurate difference calculation between Survivor and American Idol winners.
